newsitem.title: INDIA: India L&T for minority in steel venture.
newsitem.headline: India L&T for minority in steel venture.

text.p: Indian construction and engineering firm Larsen & Toubro (L&T) is looking for a minority participation in a steel venture, company officials said.
"We are looking for a five to 10 percent investment (in a proposed joint venture)," company chairman S.D. Kulkarni told reporters after a news conference.
"Our major interest is only for EPC (engineering, procurement and construction)," he added.
Kulkarni said L&T was talking to global steel majors, including some Japanese firms, but declined to elaborate saying negotiations were at a premature stage.
